**回答：**

Fair — consistency matters. Every other view goes through a WinForms-side controller that wraps the Api class. Campaign shouldn't be the odd one out.

**File to create:** `CRM_Morcaffein/Controllers/CampaignController.cs`

```csharp
using CRM_Morcaffein.api.DTOs;
using CRM_Morcaffein.winforms.Services;
using CRM_Morcaffein.winforms.Services.Api;

namespace CRM_Morcaffein.Controllers
{
    /// <summary>
    /// UI controller for the Campaign tab (WinForms). Pure coordination: the View calls
    /// these methods, they forward to the API. All business rules live on the API side.
    ///
    /// Also responsible for invalidating the POS's CampaignCache whenever a Manager
    /// creates, edits, activates, or deactivates a campaign — otherwise the POS would
    /// keep serving stale active-campaign lists until the app restarts.
    /// </summary>
    public class CampaignController
    {
        private readonly CampaignApi _api;

        public CampaignController()
        {
            _api = new CampaignApi();
        }

        // ---- List ----

        /// <summary>Every campaign regardless of status — the Manager's list.</summary>
        public Task<List<CampaignResponseDto>> GetAllAsync()
            => _api.GetForManagementAsync();

        /// <summary>Currently-active campaigns only — used by the POS.</summary>
        public Task<List<CampaignResponseDto>> GetActiveAsync()
            => _api.GetActiveCampaignsAsync();

        public Task<CampaignResponseDto?> GetByIdAsync(int campaignId)
            => _api.GetByIdAsync(campaignId);

        // ---- Mutations ----
        //
        // Each mutation invalidates CampaignCache on success, so the POS picks up the
        // change without needing an app restart. Invalidating on failure would be wrong —
        // a rejected edit shouldn't reset the cache.

        public async Task<CampaignResponseDto> CreateAsync(
            string promoName, string promoCategory, string discountType,
            decimal discountValue, string targetTier,
            decimal? minPurchaseAmount, decimal? maxDiscountAmount,
            int maxRedemptionsPerCustomer, DateTime startDate, DateTime endDate,
            int madeByEmployeeId)
        {
            var request = new CreateCampaignRequest
            {
                PromoName = promoName,
                PromoCategory = promoCategory,
                DiscountType = discountType,
                DiscountValue = discountValue,
                TargetTier = targetTier,
                MinPurchaseAmount = minPurchaseAmount,
                MaxDiscountAmount = maxDiscountAmount,
                MaxRedemptionsPerCustomer = maxRedemptionsPerCustomer,
                StartDate = startDate,
                EndDate = endDate,
                MadeBy = madeByEmployeeId,
            };

            var result = await _api.CreateAsync(request);
            CampaignCache.Reset();
            return result;
        }

        public async Task<CampaignResponseDto> UpdateAsync(
            int campaignId,
            string promoName, string promoCategory, string discountType,
            decimal discountValue, string targetTier,
            decimal? minPurchaseAmount, decimal? maxDiscountAmount,
            int maxRedemptionsPerCustomer, DateTime startDate, DateTime endDate,
            int madeByEmployeeId)
        {
            var request = new UpdateCampaignRequest
            {
                PromoName = promoName,
                PromoCategory = promoCategory,
                DiscountType = discountType,
                DiscountValue = discountValue,
                TargetTier = targetTier,
                MinPurchaseAmount = minPurchaseAmount,
                MaxDiscountAmount = maxDiscountAmount,
                MaxRedemptionsPerCustomer = maxRedemptionsPerCustomer,
                StartDate = startDate,
                EndDate = endDate,
                MadeBy = madeByEmployeeId,
            };

            var result = await _api.UpdateAsync(campaignId, request);
            CampaignCache.Reset();
            return result;
        }

        public async Task<CampaignResponseDto> ActivateAsync(int campaignId, int performedByEmployeeId)
        {
            var result = await _api.ActivateAsync(campaignId, performedByEmployeeId);
            CampaignCache.Reset();
            return result;
        }

        public async Task<CampaignResponseDto> DeactivateAsync(int campaignId, int performedByEmployeeId)
        {
            var result = await _api.DeactivateAsync(campaignId, performedByEmployeeId);
            CampaignCache.Reset();
            return result;
        }
    }
}
```

## Why `CampaignCache.Reset()` is in here

You have `CRM_Morcaffein.winforms.Services.CampaignCache` — a session-scoped cache that the POS reads when applying promos. Once you can create/edit/activate/deactivate campaigns from the Manager side, that cache becomes stale the moment a mutation happens. Without a reset, the POS would keep serving the pre-mutation active list until the app restarts.

`CampaignCache.Reset()` already exists (from the earlier bundle). This is where it gets called.

The reset is **on success only** — if the API rejects the mutation, the cache is still correct, so no reason to invalidate it.

## What this needs from the rest of the app

- `CampaignCache` — already exists in `CRM_Morcaffein.winforms.Services`. No changes needed.
- `CreateCampaignRequest`, `UpdateCampaignRequest`, `CampaignActionRequest` — already exist after M3.3.
- `CampaignResponseDto` — already has `Status` after M3.3.

Nothing else needs touching for this patch to build. `FrmMain` still shows the Campaign placeholder — that gets replaced in M3.6.

**File to create:** `CRM_Morcaffein/Views/Controls/CampaignCardControl.cs`

Modeled on `ProductCardControl` — a `Panel` that paints itself in `OnPaint` with no child controls, clickable. Simpler than the product card because there's no image and no size-button row.

```csharp
using CRM_Morcaffein.api.DTOs;
using CRM_Morcaffein.Theme;

namespace CRM_Morcaffein.winforms.Views.Controls
{
    /// <summary>
    /// One campaign tile on the Manager's Campaign tab. Paints itself entirely in
    /// OnPaint with no child controls (same convention as ProductCardControl — cheaper
    /// to build, no layout flicker when many cards are created at once).
    ///
    /// Layout:
    ///   [ Campaign name (bold, 2 lines max) ]
    ///   [ Category label (muted small)      ]
    ///   [ Discount summary (brand color)    ]
    ///   [ Date range (muted small)          ]
    ///   [ Status pill (bottom)              ]
    ///
    /// Click anywhere on the card to open the detail modal — the whole tile is the
    /// hit target, there are no interactive sub-regions.
    /// </summary>
    public class CampaignCardControl : Panel
    {
        public CampaignResponseDto Campaign { get; }

        public event EventHandler? CardClicked;

        // ---- Card metrics ----
        private const int CardPadding = 12;
        private const int NameHeight = 40;     // room for up to two lines
        private const int CategoryHeight = 20;
        private const int DiscountHeight = 28;
        private const int DateRangeHeight = 20;
        private const int StatusHeight = 24;

        // ---- Shared paint resources (static so all cards share one instance) ----
        private static readonly Font NameFont = BrandPalette.BrandFontBold(11f);
        private static readonly Font CategoryFont = BrandPalette.BrandFontRegular(8.5f);
        private static readonly Font DiscountFont = BrandPalette.BrandFontBold(13f);
        private static readonly Font DateFont = BrandPalette.BrandFontRegular(8.5f);
        private static readonly Font StatusFont = BrandPalette.BrandFontBold(9f);

        private static readonly SolidBrush NameBrush = new(BrandPalette.NeutralText);
        private static readonly SolidBrush CategoryBrush = new(BrandPalette.NeutralTextMuted);
        private static readonly SolidBrush DiscountBrush = new(BrandPalette.Brand);
        private static readonly SolidBrush DateBrush = new(BrandPalette.NeutralTextMuted);

        private static readonly StringFormat WrapEllipsisFormat = new()
        {
            Trimming = StringTrimming.EllipsisCharacter,
            FormatFlags = StringFormatFlags.LineLimit,
        };

        public CampaignCardControl(CampaignResponseDto campaign)
        {
            Campaign = campaign;

            Size = new Size(260, 200);
            Margin = new Padding(8);
            BackColor = BrandPalette.SurfacePrimary;
            Cursor = Cursors.Hand;

            SetStyle(ControlStyles.UserPaint
                   | ControlStyles.AllPaintingInWmPaint
                   | ControlStyles.OptimizedDoubleBuffer
                   | ControlStyles.ResizeRedraw, true);

            Click += (s, e) => CardClicked?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);

            MouseEnter += (s, e) => { BackColor = BrandPalette.Tint90; Invalidate(); };
            MouseLeave += (s, e) => { BackColor = BrandPalette.SurfacePrimary; Invalidate(); };
        }

        protected override void OnPaint(PaintEventArgs e)
        {
            var g = e.Graphics;
            g.TextRenderingHint = System.Drawing.Text.TextRenderingHint.ClearTypeGridFit;

            // Border
            using var borderPen = new Pen(BrandPalette.Border);
            g.DrawRectangle(borderPen, 0, 0, Width - 1, Height - 1);

            int y = CardPadding;

            // ---- Campaign name (up to two lines) ----
            var nameRect = new RectangleF(
                CardPadding, y,
                Width - CardPadding * 2,
                NameHeight);
            g.DrawString(Campaign.PromoName, NameFont, NameBrush, nameRect, WrapEllipsisFormat);
            y += NameHeight;

            // ---- Category ----
            var categoryRect = new RectangleF(
                CardPadding, y,
                Width - CardPadding * 2,
                CategoryHeight);
            g.DrawString(Campaign.PromoCategory, CategoryFont, CategoryBrush, categoryRect, WrapEllipsisFormat);
            y += CategoryHeight + 4;

            // ---- Discount summary ----
            var discountText = FormatDiscount(Campaign.DiscountType, Campaign.DiscountValue);
            var discountRect = new RectangleF(
                CardPadding, y,
                Width - CardPadding * 2,
                DiscountHeight);
            g.DrawString(discountText, DiscountFont, DiscountBrush, discountRect, WrapEllipsisFormat);
            y += DiscountHeight + 2;

            // ---- Date range ----
            var dateText = $"{Campaign.StartDate:MMM d, yyyy} – {Campaign.EndDate:MMM d, yyyy}";
            var dateRect = new RectangleF(
                CardPadding, y,
                Width - CardPadding * 2,
                DateRangeHeight);
            g.DrawString(dateText, DateFont, DateBrush, dateRect, WrapEllipsisFormat);

            // ---- Status pill, bottom of the card ----
            DrawStatusPill(g);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Renders the campaign's status as a filled pill at the bottom-left of the card.
        /// Active = filled brand tint, Inactive/Pending/Rejected = muted neutral.
        /// </summary>
        private void DrawStatusPill(Graphics g)
        {
            var label = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(Campaign.Status) ? "—" : Campaign.Status;

            var isActive = label.Equals("Active", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

            var fillColor = isActive ? BrandPalette.Tint75 : BrandPalette.Tone80;
            var textColor = isActive ? BrandPalette.Shade25 : BrandPalette.Tone35;

            // Measure the text so the pill hugs its contents.
            var textSize = g.MeasureString(label, StatusFont);

            var pillPaddingX = 10;
            var pillWidth = (int)Math.Ceiling(textSize.Width) + pillPaddingX * 2;
            var pillRect = new Rectangle(
                CardPadding,
                Height - CardPadding - StatusHeight,
                pillWidth,
                StatusHeight);

            using var fillBrush = new SolidBrush(fillColor);
            using var textBrush = new SolidBrush(textColor);

            // Rounded-ish pill via a small corner radius approximation.
            var radius = StatusHeight / 2;
            using var path = RoundedRect(pillRect, radius);
            g.SmoothingMode = System.Drawing.Drawing2D.SmoothingMode.AntiAlias;
            g.FillPath(fillBrush, path);

            var textRect = new RectangleF(
                pillRect.X,
                pillRect.Y,
                pillRect.Width,
                pillRect.Height);
            var centered = new StringFormat
            {
                Alignment = StringAlignment.Center,
                LineAlignment = StringAlignment.Center,
            };
            g.DrawString(label, StatusFont, textBrush, textRect, centered);
        }

        private static System.Drawing.Drawing2D.GraphicsPath RoundedRect(Rectangle rect, int radius)
        {
            var path = new System.Drawing.Drawing2D.GraphicsPath();
            var d = radius * 2;

            path.AddArc(rect.X, rect.Y, d, d, 180, 90);
            path.AddArc(rect.Right - d, rect.Y, d, d, 270, 90);
            path.AddArc(rect.Right - d, rect.Bottom - d, d, d, 0, 90);
            path.AddArc(rect.X, rect.Bottom - d, d, d, 90, 90);
            path.CloseFigure();
            return path;
        }

        private static string FormatDiscount(string discountType, decimal discountValue)
        {
            if (discountType.Equals("Percentage", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                return $"{discountValue:0.##}% off";

            return $"₱{discountValue:0.##} off";
        }
    }
}
```

## What this control does

- Paints itself as a 260×200 tile with five stacked elements: name, category, discount, dates, and a status pill at the bottom.
- On hover, background lightens (same pattern as `ProductCardControl`).
- Click anywhere on the card raises `CardClicked`. The campaign management view (M3.6) subscribes and opens the detail modal.
- The status pill is tinted differently for Active vs. everything else — Active gets the brand tint, others get a muted grey. No color-coding for tiers or statuses elsewhere in the app; this is a small exception for the campaign cards, but it uses existing BrandPalette tokens so it's not introducing a new hue.

## Two things I want to flag

**1. This card has no image and no internal sub-controls**, so unlike `ProductCardControl` there's no `RecomputeSizeButtonRects` or interactive sub-region — the whole panel is the hit target. If later you want an inline "Activate" button on the card, that becomes a child control and this class gets more complex. Not now.

**2. The `Status` pill uses a rounded rectangle path.** `ProductCardControl` draws only straight rectangles and lines — this is the first control that draws a rounded shape. If the visual doesn't match the brand's flat aesthetic, tell me and I'll switch it to a straight-cornered badge.

Should compile clean — it depends on `CampaignResponseDto` (which now has `Status`) and `BrandPalette`, both of which exist. No behavior change yet since nothing instantiates it.

M3.6. The `CampaignManagementView`. This is the big one.

**File to create:** `CRM_Morcaffein/Views/Controls/CampaignManagementView.cs`

Code-only (no `.Designer.cs`), matching the pattern of `ManageUsersView` and `TransactionView` — full layout built in `BuildLayout()`.

**What it is:**

- Full-width card, same outer shape as Customers/Feedback/ManageUsers.
- Header: search box on the left, "+ New Campaign" button on the right.
- Below the header: a scroll host containing a `TableLayoutPanel` of `CampaignCardControl`s, four columns per row.
- No left drawer. Clicking a card opens the detail modal (M3.7) — not built yet, so for now the click handler just shows a toast or does nothing until M3.7 lands.

The card-grid pattern mirrors `TransactionView`'s drinks area: `TableLayoutPanel` inside an `AutoScroll` wrapper, grid absolutely positioned, explicit height.

```csharp
using CRM_Morcaffein.Controllers;
using CRM_Morcaffein.api.DTOs;
using CRM_Morcaffein.Session;
using CRM_Morcaffein.Theme;

namespace CRM_Morcaffein.winforms.Views.Controls
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The Manager's Campaign tab. A grid of campaign cards — no drawer, no table.
    /// Clicking a card opens the detail modal (FrmCampaignDetail), which handles editing
    /// and the activate/deactivate actions.
    ///
    /// This view is Manager-only. Baristas never see the tab (FrmMain doesn't include it
    /// for them). Admin also doesn't see it — their Campaign oversight goes through the
    /// Approvals tab, not here.
    /// </summary>
    public class CampaignManagementView : UserControl
    {
        private const int CampaignColumnCount = 4;
        private const int CardWidth = 260;
        private const int CardHeight = 200;
        private const int CardMargin = 8;
        private const int RowHeight = CardHeight + CardMargin * 2;   // 216

        private readonly CampaignController _controller;

        // Header
        private Panel _cardHeaderPanel = null!;
        private TextBox _searchTxtBx = null!;
        private Button _newCampaignBtn = null!;

        // Card grid (mirrors TransactionView's drinks area)
        private Panel _cardsScrollHost = null!;
        private TableLayoutPanel _cardsGrid = null!;
        private Label _emptyStateLabel = null!;

        // Debounce for the search box — avoids one API call per keystroke.
        private System.Windows.Forms.Timer _searchDebounce = null!;

        // In-memory list of everything fetched; search filters it client-side.
        private List<CampaignResponseDto> _allCampaigns = new();

        // Filter signature so we don't rebuild the grid when nothing changed.
        private string _lastFilterSignature = string.Empty;

        public CampaignManagementView()
        {
            _controller = new CampaignController();
            BuildLayout();
            Load += async (s, e) => await ReloadAsync();
        }

        protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
        {
            if (disposing)
                _searchDebounce?.Dispose();
            base.Dispose(disposing);
        }

        // =====================================================================
        // LAYOUT
        // =====================================================================

        private void BuildLayout()
        {
            Dock = DockStyle.Fill;
            BackColor = BrandPalette.SurfaceSecondary;

            var cardOuterPanel = new Panel
            {
                Dock = DockStyle.Fill,
                BackColor = BrandPalette.SurfaceSecondary,
                Padding = new Padding(24),
            };

            var tableCardPanel = new Panel
            {
                Dock = DockStyle.Fill,
                BackColor = BrandPalette.SurfacePrimary,
                BorderStyle = BorderStyle.FixedSingle,
            };

            // ---- Header: search + New Campaign ----
            _cardHeaderPanel = new Panel
            {
                Dock = DockStyle.Top,
                Height = 60,
                BackColor = BrandPalette.SurfacePrimary,
            };

            _searchTxtBx = new TextBox
            {
                Location = new Point(16, 16),
                Size = new Size(300, 28),
                PlaceholderText = "Search by name or category",
                Font = BrandPalette.BrandFontRegular(10f),
            };

            // Debounce: rebuild the grid only after the user pauses typing.
            _searchDebounce = new System.Windows.Forms.Timer { Interval = 200 };
            _searchDebounce.Tick += (s, e) =>
            {
                _searchDebounce.Stop();
                RefreshCardsPanel();
            };

            _searchTxtBx.TextChanged += (s, e) =>
            {
                _searchDebounce.Stop();
                _searchDebounce.Start();
            };

            _newCampaignBtn = new Button
            {
                Text = "+ New Campaign",
                Size = new Size(170, 32),
                Location = new Point(16, 14),
                FlatStyle = FlatStyle.Flat,
                BackColor = BrandPalette.ButtonPrimaryFill,
                ForeColor = BrandPalette.ButtonPrimaryText,
                Font = BrandPalette.BrandFontRegular(9.5f),
                Cursor = Cursors.Hand,
            };
            _newCampaignBtn.FlatAppearance.BorderSize = 0;
            _newCampaignBtn.Click += (s, e) => OpenCreateModal();

            var headerDivider = new Panel
            {
                Dock = DockStyle.Bottom,
                Height = 1,
                BackColor = BrandPalette.Border,
            };

            _cardHeaderPanel.Controls.Add(_newCampaignBtn);
            _cardHeaderPanel.Controls.Add(_searchTxtBx);
            _cardHeaderPanel.Controls.Add(headerDivider);

            // Reposition the button to hug the right edge whenever the header resizes.
            _cardHeaderPanel.Resize += (s, e) =>
            {
                _newCampaignBtn.Left = _cardHeaderPanel.ClientSize.Width - _newCampaignBtn.Width - 16;
                _newCampaignBtn.Top = 14;
            };

            // ---- Card grid ----
            // Same wrapper-Panel-with-AutoScroll + absolutely-positioned TableLayoutPanel
            // pattern as the drinks area in TransactionView. The wrapper scrolls; the grid
            // is Dock=None and its Width/Height are set explicitly.
            _cardsScrollHost = new Panel
            {
                Dock = DockStyle.Fill,
                AutoScroll = true,
                BackColor = BrandPalette.SurfacePrimary,
            };

            _cardsGrid = new TableLayoutPanel
            {
                Location = new Point(0, 0),
                ColumnCount = CampaignColumnCount,
                RowCount = 0,
                AutoScroll = false,
                Padding = new Padding(16),
                BackColor = BrandPalette.SurfacePrimary,
                GrowStyle = TableLayoutPanelGrowStyle.AddRows,
            };

            for (int i = 0; i < CampaignColumnCount; i++)
                _cardsGrid.ColumnStyles.Add(new ColumnStyle(SizeType.Percent, 100f / CampaignColumnCount));

            _emptyStateLabel = new Label
            {
                Text = "No campaigns yet. Click \"+ New Campaign\" to create one.",
                Dock = DockStyle.Fill,
                TextAlign = ContentAlignment.MiddleCenter,
                Font = BrandPalette.BrandFontRegular(10f),
                ForeColor = BrandPalette.NeutralTextMuted,
                BackColor = BrandPalette.SurfacePrimary,
            };

            _cardsScrollHost.Controls.Add(_cardsGrid);
            _cardsScrollHost.Resize += (s, e) => SyncCardsGridWidth();

            tableCardPanel.Controls.Add(_cardsScrollHost);
            tableCardPanel.Controls.Add(_cardHeaderPanel);

            cardOuterPanel.Controls.Add(tableCardPanel);
            Controls.Add(cardOuterPanel);
        }

        private void SyncCardsGridWidth()
        {
            if (_cardsScrollHost is null || _cardsGrid is null)
                return;

            var hostWidth = _cardsScrollHost.ClientSize.Width;
            if (hostWidth <= 0)
                return;

            _cardsGrid.Width = hostWidth;
        }

        // =====================================================================
        // DATA LOADING
        // =====================================================================

        private async Task ReloadAsync()
        {
            try
            {
                _allCampaigns = await _controller.GetAllAsync();
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                MessageBox.Show(FindForm(), ex.Message, "Error loading campaigns");
                return;
            }

            // Force a rebuild regardless of the filter signature — the underlying data
            // changed, so even the same filter should produce a fresh render.
            _lastFilterSignature = string.Empty;
            RefreshCardsPanel();
        }

        // =====================================================================
        // CARD GRID
        // =====================================================================

        private void RefreshCardsPanel()
        {
            var searchTerm = _searchTxtBx.Text?.Trim() ?? string.Empty;
            var signature = $"campaigns|{searchTerm}";

            if (signature == _lastFilterSignature && _cardsGrid.Controls.Count > 0)
                return;

            _lastFilterSignature = signature;

            _cardsGrid.SuspendLayout();
            try
            {
                _cardsGrid.Controls.Clear();
                _cardsGrid.RowStyles.Clear();
                _cardsGrid.RowCount = 0;

                // Filter: name or category contains the search term (case-insensitive).
                var filtered = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(searchTerm)
                    ? _allCampaigns
                    : _allCampaigns.Where(c =>
                        c.PromoName.Contains(searchTerm, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                        c.PromoCategory.Contains(searchTerm, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                      .ToList();

                if (filtered.Count == 0)
                {
                    _cardsGrid.RowCount = 1;
                    _cardsGrid.RowStyles.Add(new RowStyle(SizeType.Percent, 100f));
                    _cardsGrid.Controls.Add(_emptyStateLabel, 0, 0);
                    _cardsGrid.SetColumnSpan(_emptyStateLabel, CampaignColumnCount);

                    SyncCardsGridWidth();
                    _cardsGrid.Height = Math.Max(
                        _cardsScrollHost.ClientSize.Height,
                        _cardsGrid.Padding.Top + _cardsGrid.Padding.Bottom + 60);
                    return;
                }

                var rows = (filtered.Count + CampaignColumnCount - 1) / CampaignColumnCount;

                for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++)
                    _cardsGrid.RowStyles.Add(new RowStyle(SizeType.Absolute, RowHeight));

                // Spacer row — absorbs leftover vertical space so the last product row
                // doesn't stretch (same fix as TransactionView).
                _cardsGrid.RowStyles.Add(new RowStyle(SizeType.Percent, 100f));
                _cardsGrid.RowCount = rows + 1;

                for (int i = 0; i < filtered.Count; i++)
                {
                    var campaign = filtered[i];
                    var card = new CampaignCardControl(campaign)
                    {
                        Dock = DockStyle.Fill,
                        Margin = new Padding(CardMargin),
                    };
                    card.CardClicked += (s, e) => OpenDetailModal(campaign);

                    var row = i / CampaignColumnCount;
                    var col = i % CampaignColumnCount;
                    _cardsGrid.Controls.Add(card, col, row);
                }

                SyncCardsGridWidth();
                var gridHeight = rows * RowHeight
                    + _cardsGrid.Padding.Top + _cardsGrid.Padding.Bottom;
                _cardsGrid.Height = Math.Max(gridHeight, _cardsScrollHost.ClientSize.Height);
            }
            finally
            {
                _cardsGrid.ResumeLayout(performLayout: true);
                _cardsScrollHost.PerformLayout();
            }
        }

        // =====================================================================
        // MODAL HOOKS (stubs until M3.7 lands)
        // =====================================================================

        private void OpenCreateModal()
        {
            // M3.7 will open FrmCampaignDetail in "create" mode.
            MessageBox.Show(FindForm(),
                "Create-campaign modal is M3.7 — not yet built.",
                "Not Implemented", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Information);
        }

        private void OpenDetailModal(CampaignResponseDto campaign)
        {
            // M3.7 will open FrmCampaignDetail in "view" mode for this campaign.
            MessageBox.Show(FindForm(),
                $"Campaign detail for \"{campaign.PromoName}\" is M3.7 — not yet built.",
                "Not Implemented", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Information);
        }
    }
}
```

## What this view does

- Loads all campaigns via `CampaignController.GetAllAsync()` (which hits `GET /campaigns/manage`).
- Renders them as `CampaignCardControl`s in a 4-column `TableLayoutPanel` inside an `AutoScroll` wrapper.
- Search box filters client-side by name or category, with a 200ms debounce.
- Empty state shows a centered message if there are no campaigns or the filter matches nothing.
- Cards are clickable but the two modal hooks are stubs — M3.7 replaces them.

## Notes on the design

**Client-side filtering, not API.** `GetAllAsync` fetches everything once per tab load; search filters in memory. For a coffee shop's campaign list (a handful of active + inactive promos), this is fine — no need for a server round-trip per keystroke. Same rationale as the drinks grid.

**The card grid uses `RowStyle.Absolute` + a `Percent(100)` spacer row.** Same trick as `TransactionView`: the spacer absorbs leftover vertical space so the last row of cards doesn't stretch to fill the panel. If you remember the drinks area bug, this is the same fix applied proactively.

**No pagination.** Campaigns are a small list; a `PaginationControl` here would be overkill. If the list grows past ~50, revisit.

**No auto-refresh.** Tab is loaded once per click (FrmMain builds a fresh view each time), so it always shows current data.

## Rebuild

Should compile clean — depends on `CampaignController` (from M3.4b), `CampaignCardControl` (from M3.5), `CampaignResponseDto`, `BrandPalette`. All exist.

**What's next:** M3.7 is `FrmCampaignDetail` — the modal that opens when you click a card or click "+ New Campaign". That's the last big piece of M3. Then M3.8 wires the view into `FrmMain`.

Prompt me for M3.7 when ready.

M3.7. `FrmCampaignDetail` — the modal. This is the last big piece of M3.

Same shape as the other modals in the app: a `Form` with `FixedDialog` border, built entirely in code, opened via `ShowDialog(FindForm())`.

The modal has **three modes**: View (read-only summary + actions), Edit (fields are editable, Save/Cancel), Create (like Edit but with an empty form and no "Activate/Deactivate"). Same form for all three; behavior changes based on how it was opened.

**File to create:** `CRM_Morcaffein/Views/Forms/FrmCampaignDetail.cs` — or `Views/FrmCampaignDetail.cs` depending on where the other Frm* files live. From the bundle, they're in `CRM_Morcaffein/Views/`. So `CRM_Morcaffein/Views/FrmCampaignDetail.cs`.

```csharp
using CRM_Morcaffein.Controllers;
using CRM_Morcaffein.api.DTOs;
using CRM_Morcaffein.Session;
using CRM_Morcaffein.Theme;
using CRM_Morcaffein.domain.entities;

namespace CRM_Morcaffein.winforms.Views
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Modal for viewing, creating, and editing a campaign. Three modes:
    ///
    ///   Create  — opened by "+ New Campaign". Empty form, Create / Cancel buttons.
    ///   View    — opened by clicking a card. Read-only summary + Edit / Activate /
    ///             Deactivate / Close buttons.
    ///   Edit    — entered from View by clicking Edit. Same fields as Create, but
    ///             pre-populated and saving via the update endpoint.
    ///
    /// The modal is code-only (no Designer.cs), matching FrmCreateEmployee and
    /// FrmItemCustomizer.
    /// </summary>
    public class FrmCampaignDetail : Form
    {
        private enum Mode { Create, View, Edit }

        private readonly CampaignController _controller;
        private readonly CampaignResponseDto? _existing;

        private Mode _mode;

        // Fields
        private TextBox _nameTxtBx = null!;
        private ComboBox _categoryCombo = null!;
        private ComboBox _discountTypeCombo = null!;
        private NumericUpDown _discountValueNud = null!;
        private ComboBox _targetTierCombo = null!;
        private NumericUpDown _minPurchaseNud = null!;
        private CheckBox _hasMinPurchaseChk = null!;
        private NumericUpDown _maxDiscountNud = null!;
        private CheckBox _hasMaxDiscountChk = null!;
        private NumericUpDown _maxRedemptionsNud = null!;
        private DateTimePicker _startDatePicker = null!;
        private DateTimePicker _endDatePicker = null!;

        private Label _errorLabel = null!;

        // Mode-dependent controls
        private Panel _formPanel = null!;         // holds the editable fields
        private Panel _viewPanel = null!;         // holds the read-only summary
        private Panel _actionRow = null!;         // holds the buttons

        private Button _primaryBtn = null!;       // Create or Save
        private Button _editBtn = null!;          // visible in View
        private Button _activateBtn = null!;      // visible in View
        private Button _deactivateBtn = null!;    // visible in View
        private Button _cancelBtn = null!;        // visible in Create/Edit (as Cancel)
        private Button _closeBtn = null!;         // visible in View

        /// <summary>True if a mutation (create/edit/activate/deactivate) was performed.</summary>
        public bool ChangedSomething { get; private set; }

        private FrmCampaignDetail(CampaignController controller, CampaignResponseDto? existing, Mode initialMode)
        {
            _controller = controller;
            _existing = existing;
            _mode = initialMode;

            Text = initialMode switch
            {
                Mode.Create => "New Campaign",
                Mode.Edit => "Edit Campaign",
                _ => "Campaign Detail",
            };

            FormBorderStyle = FormBorderStyle.FixedDialog;
            StartPosition = FormStartPosition.CenterParent;
            MaximizeBox = false;
            MinimizeBox = false;
            ClientSize = new Size(540, 640);
            BackColor = BrandPalette.SurfacePrimary;
            Font = BrandPalette.BrandFontRegular(9.5f);
            Padding = new Padding(24);

            BuildLayout();

            if (initialMode == Mode.Create)
                PopulateEmptyForm();
            else
                PopulateFromExisting();

            ApplyMode();
        }

        // =====================================================================
        // FACTORY METHODS — how the caller opens the modal
        // =====================================================================

        public static FrmCampaignDetail ForCreate(CampaignController controller)
            => new(controller, existing: null, Mode.Create);

        public static FrmCampaignDetail ForView(CampaignController controller, CampaignResponseDto campaign)
            => new(controller, campaign, Mode.View);

        // =====================================================================
        // LAYOUT
        // =====================================================================

        private void BuildLayout()
        {
            // ---- Title ----
            var titleLabel = new Label
            {
                Dock = DockStyle.Top,
                Height = 30,
                Font = BrandPalette.BrandFontBold(14f),
                ForeColor = BrandPalette.NeutralText,
                Text = _mode == Mode.Create ? "Create Campaign" : "Campaign Details",
            };

            var subtitleLabel = new Label
            {
                Dock = DockStyle.Top,
                Height = 36,
                Font = BrandPalette.BrandFontRegular(9f),
                ForeColor = BrandPalette.NeutralTextMuted,
                Text = _mode == Mode.Create
                    ? "Fill in the campaign details. It goes live as soon as it's created."
                    : "Review the campaign below. Edit or toggle its active state from the buttons.",
            };

            // ---- View panel (read-only summary) ----
            _viewPanel = BuildViewPanel();

            // ---- Form panel (editable fields) ----
            _formPanel = BuildFormPanel();

            // ---- Error label ----
            _errorLabel = new Label
            {
                Dock = DockStyle.Bottom,
                Height = 26,
                Font = BrandPalette.BrandFontRegular(8.5f),
                ForeColor = BrandPalette.StatusNegativeFill,
                TextAlign = ContentAlignment.MiddleLeft,
            };

            // ---- Action row (buttons) ----
            _actionRow = BuildActionRow();

            // Compose. Dock order matters — added bottom-to-top visually.
            Controls.Add(_actionRow);
            Controls.Add(_errorLabel);
            Controls.Add(_formPanel);
            Controls.Add(_viewPanel);
            Controls.Add(subtitleLabel);
            Controls.Add(titleLabel);
        }

        private Panel BuildViewPanel()
        {
            var panel = new Panel
            {
                Dock = DockStyle.Fill,
                BackColor = BrandPalette.SurfaceCard,
                BorderStyle = BorderStyle.FixedSingle,
                Padding = new Padding(18, 14, 18, 14),

        }

            // Discount value (to the right of type)

            _discountValueNud = new NumericUpDown

                Minimum = 0.01m,
                Maximum = 100000m,
                Value = 10m,

            panel.Controls.Add(_discountValueNud);
            y += rowH;

            // Target tier
            AddLabel("Target tier *");
            _targetTierCombo = new ComboBox
            {
                Location = new Point(0, y + labelH),
                Size = new Size(fieldW, fieldH),
                DropDownStyle = ComboBoxStyle.DropDownList,
                Font = BrandPalette.BrandFontRegular(9.5f),
            };
            _targetTierCombo.Items.AddRange(new object[] { "All", "Regular", "Silver", "Gold" });
            _targetTierCombo.SelectedIndex = 0;
            panel.Controls.Add(_targetTierCombo);
            y += rowH;

            // Min purchase (checkbox + value)
            _hasMinPurchaseChk = new CheckBox
            {
                Text = "Minimum purchase amount",
                Location = new Point(0, y),
                AutoSize = true,
                Font = BrandPalette.BrandFontRegular(9f),
                ForeColor = BrandPalette.NeutralTextMuted,
            };
            _minPurchaseNud = new NumericUpDown
            {
                Location = new Point(0, y + labelH + 4),
                Size = new Size(220, fieldH),
                DecimalPlaces = 2,
                Minimum = 0m,

                Font = BrandPalette.BrandFontRegular(9.5f),

            _hasMinPurchaseChk.CheckedChanged += (s, e) => _minPurchaseNud.Enabled = _hasMinPurchaseChk.Checked;
            panel.Controls.Add(_hasMinPurchaseChk);
            panel.Controls.Add(_minPurchaseNud);

            // Max discount (checkbox + value) — right column
            _hasMaxDiscountChk = new CheckBox
            {
                Text = "Maximum discount cap",
                Location = new Point(244, y),
                AutoSize = true,
                Font = BrandPalette.BrandFontRegular(9f),
                ForeColor = BrandPalette.NeutralTextMuted,
            };
            _maxDiscountNud = new NumericUpDown
            {
                Location = new Point(244, y + labelH + 4),
                Size = new Size(220, fieldH),
                DecimalPlaces = 2,
                Minimum = 0m,
                Maximum = 100000m,
                Enabled = false,
                Font = BrandPalette.BrandFontRegular(9.5f),

            _hasMaxDiscountChk.CheckedChanged += (s, e) => _maxDiscountNud.Enabled = _hasMaxDiscountChk.Checked;
            panel.Controls.Add(_hasMaxDiscountChk);
            panel.Controls.Add(_maxDiscountNud);
            y += rowH + 12;

            // Max redemptions per customer
            AddLabel("Max redemptions per customer *");
            _maxRedemptionsNud = new NumericUpDown
            {
                Location = new Point(0, y + labelH),

            // Start date

        private Panel BuildActionRow()
        {
            var row = new Panel
            {
                Dock = DockStyle.Bottom,
                Height = 52,
                BackColor = BrandPalette.SurfacePrimary,
            };

            // Create primary button (Create or Save)
            _primaryBtn = new Button
            {
                Text = "Create Campaign",
                Size = new Size(160, 36),
                Location = new Point(0, 8),
                FlatStyle = FlatStyle.Flat,
                BackColor = BrandPalette.ButtonPrimaryFill,
                ForeColor = BrandPalette.ButtonPrimaryText,
                Font = BrandPalette.BrandFontBold(9.5f),
                Cursor = Cursors.Hand,
            };
            _primaryBtn.FlatAppearance.BorderSize = 0;
            _primaryBtn.Click += PrimaryBtn_Click;

            // Edit (View mode)
            _editBtn = new Button
            {
                Text = "Edit",
                Size = new Size(100, 36),
                Location = new Point(0, 8),
                FlatStyle = FlatStyle.Flat,
                BackColor = BrandPalette.ButtonSecondaryFill,
                ForeColor = BrandPalette.ButtonSecondaryText,
                Font = BrandPalette.BrandFontRegular(9.5f),
                Cursor = Cursors.Hand,
            };
            _editBtn.FlatAppearance.BorderSize = 0;
            _editBtn.Click += (s, e) => SwitchToEdit();

            // Activate (View mode)
            _activateBtn = new Button
            {
                Text = "Activate",
                Size = new Size(110, 36),
                Location = new Point(110, 8),
                FlatStyle = FlatStyle.Flat,
                BackColor = BrandPalette.ButtonSecondaryFill,
                ForeColor = BrandPalette.ButtonSecondaryText,
                Font = BrandPalette.BrandFontRegular(9.5f),
                Cursor = Cursors.Hand,
            };
            _activateBtn.FlatAppearance.BorderSize = 0;
            _activateBtn.Click += (s, e) => ToggleActivation(activate: true);

            // Deactivate (View mode)
            _deactivateBtn = new Button
            {
                Text = "Deactivate",
                Size = new Size(110, 36),
                Location = new Point(230, 8),
                FlatStyle = FlatStyle.Flat,
                BackColor = BrandPalette.ButtonSecondaryFill,
                ForeColor = BrandPalette.StatusNegativeFill,
                Font = BrandPalette.BrandFontRegular(9.5f),
                Cursor = Cursors.Hand,
            };
            _deactivateBtn.FlatAppearance.BorderSize = 0;
            _deactivateBtn.Click += (s, e) => ToggleActivation(activate: false);

            // Cancel (Create/Edit mode)
            _cancelBtn = new Button
            {
                Text = "Cancel",
                Size = new Size(100, 36),
                Location = new Point(0, 8),
                FlatStyle = FlatStyle.Flat,
                BackColor = BrandPalette.ButtonSecondaryFill,
                ForeColor = BrandPalette.ButtonSecondaryText,
                Font = BrandPalette.BrandFontRegular(9.5f),
                Cursor = Cursors.Hand,
            };
            _cancelBtn.FlatAppearance.BorderSize = 0;
            _cancelBtn.Click += CancelBtn_Click;

            // Close (View mode)
            _closeBtn = new Button
            {
                Text = "Close",
                Size = new Size(100, 36),
                Location = new Point(0, 8),
                FlatStyle = FlatStyle.Flat,
                BackColor = BrandPalette.ButtonSecondaryFill,
                ForeColor = BrandPalette.ButtonSecondaryText,
                Font = BrandPalette.BrandFontRegular(9.5f),
                Cursor = Cursors.Hand,
            };
            _closeBtn.FlatAppearance.BorderSize = 0;
            _closeBtn.Click += (s, e) => { DialogResult = ChangedSomething ? DialogResult.OK : DialogResult.Cancel; Close(); };

            row.Controls.Add(_closeBtn);
            row.Controls.Add(_cancelBtn);
            row.Controls.Add(_deactivateBtn);
            row.Controls.Add(_activateBtn);
            row.Controls.Add(_editBtn);
            row.Controls.Add(_primaryBtn);

            // Position all buttons right-aligned on the row whenever it resizes.
            row.Resize += (s, e) => PositionActionButtons(row);

            return row;
        }

        private void PositionActionButtons(Panel row)
        {
            var rightEdge = row.ClientSize.Width - 16;
            const int gap = 8;

            // Right-to-left packing: primary on the far right, then edit/activate/
            // deactivate stepping left, and the cancel/close buttons further left.
            void PackRight(Button btn)
            {
                if (!btn.Visible) return;
                btn.Left = rightEdge - btn.Width;
                btn.Top = 8;
                rightEdge -= btn.Width + gap;
            }

            // Reset right edge, then pack in visual order right-to-left.
            // This runs on every resize, and visibility flips on mode change, so the
            // buttons reflow whenever either changes.
            rightEdge = row.ClientSize.Width - 16;

            PackRight(_primaryBtn);
            PackRight(_editBtn);
            PackRight(_activateBtn);
            PackRight(_deactivateBtn);
            PackRight(_cancelBtn);
            PackRight(_closeBtn);
        }

        // =====================================================================
        // MODE
        // =====================================================================

        private void ApplyMode()
        {
            // Reset visibility for all mode-dependent controls
            _primaryBtn.Visible = false;
            _editBtn.Visible = false;
            _activateBtn.Visible = false;
            _deactivateBtn.Visible = false;
            _cancelBtn.Visible = false;
            _closeBtn.Visible = false;
            _viewPanel.Visible = false;
            _formPanel.Visible = false;
            _errorLabel.Text = string.Empty;

            switch (_mode)
            {
                case Mode.Create:
                    Text = "New Campaign";
                    _formPanel.Visible = true;
                    _primaryBtn.Text = "Create Campaign";
                    _primaryBtn.Visible = true;
                    _cancelBtn.Visible = true;
                    break;

                case Mode.Edit:
                    Text = "Edit Campaign";
                    _formPanel.Visible = true;
                    _primaryBtn.Text = "Save Changes";
                    _primaryBtn.Visible = true;
                    _cancelBtn.Visible = true;
                    break;

                case Mode.View:
                    Text = "Campaign Details";
                    _viewPanel.Visible = true;
                    RefreshViewPanel();
                    _editBtn.Visible = true;
                    _closeBtn.Visible = true;

                    // Only one of Activate / Deactivate is ever visible, based on status.
                    var isActive = _existing?.Status?.Equals("Active", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) == true;
                    _activateBtn.Visible = !isActive;
                    _deactivateBtn.Visible = isActive;
                    break;
            }

            // Reflow button positions after visibility changes.
            PositionActionButtons(_actionRow);
        }

        private void SwitchToEdit()
        {
            _mode = Mode.Edit;
            PopulateFromExisting();
            ApplyMode();
        }

        // =====================================================================
        // DATA BINDING
        // =====================================================================

        private void PopulateEmptyForm()
        {
            _nameTxtBx.Text = string.Empty;
            _categoryCombo.SelectedIndex = 0;
            _discountTypeCombo.SelectedIndex = 0;
            _discountValueNud.Value = 10m;
            _targetTierCombo.SelectedIndex = 0;
            _hasMinPurchaseChk.Checked = false;
            _minPurchaseNud.Value = 0m;
            _minPurchaseNud.Enabled = false;
            _hasMaxDiscountChk.Checked = false;
            _maxDiscountNud.Value = 0m;
            _maxDiscountNud.Enabled = false;
            _maxRedemptionsNud.Value = 1m;
            _startDatePicker.Value = DateTime.Today;
            _endDatePicker.Value = DateTime.Today.AddMonths(1);
        }

        private void PopulateFromExisting()
        {
            if (_existing is null) return;

            _nameTxtBx.Text = _existing.PromoName;

            var catIdx = _categoryCombo.Items.IndexOf(_existing.PromoCategory);
            _categoryCombo.SelectedIndex = catIdx >= 0 ? catIdx : 0;

            var typeIdx = _discountTypeCombo.Items.IndexOf(_existing.DiscountType);
            _discountTypeCombo.SelectedIndex = typeIdx >= 0 ? typeIdx : 0;

            _discountValueNud.Value = _existing.DiscountValue;

            var tierIdx = _targetTierCombo.Items.IndexOf(_existing.TargetTier);
            _targetTierCombo.SelectedIndex = tierIdx >= 0 ? tierIdx : 0;

            if (_existing.MinPurchaseAmount.HasValue)
            {
                _hasMinPurchaseChk.Checked = true;
                _minPurchaseNud.Value = _existing.MinPurchaseAmount.Value;
                _minPurchaseNud.Enabled = true;
            }
            else
            {
                _hasMinPurchaseChk.Checked = false;
                _minPurchaseNud.Value = 0m;
                _minPurchaseNud.Enabled = false;
            }

            if (_existing.MaxDiscountAmount.HasValue)
            {
                _hasMaxDiscountChk.Checked = true;
                _maxDiscountNud.Value = _existing.MaxDiscountAmount.Value;
                _maxDiscountNud.Enabled = true;
            }
            else
            {
                _hasMaxDiscountChk.Checked = false;
                _maxDiscountNud.Value = 0m;
                _maxDiscountNud.Enabled = false;
            }

            _maxRedemptionsNud.Value = _existing.MaxRedemptionsPerCustomer;
            _startDatePicker.Value = _existing.StartDate;
            _endDatePicker.Value = _existing.EndDate;
        }

        private void RefreshViewPanel()
        {
            if (_existing is null) return;

            _viewPanel.Controls.Clear();

            const int labelX = 18;
            const int valueX = 180;
            int y = 14;

            void AddRow(string label, string value, Font? valueFont = null, Color? valueColor = null)
            {
                _viewPanel.Controls.Add(new Label
                {
                    Text = label,
                    Location = new Point(labelX, y),
                    AutoSize = true,
                    Font = BrandPalette.BrandFontRegular(9f),
                    ForeColor = BrandPalette.NeutralTextMuted,
                });

                _viewPanel.Controls.Add(new Label
                {
                    Text = value,
                    Location = new Point(valueX, y),
                    MaximumSize = new Size(_viewPanel.Width - valueX - 18, 0),
                    AutoSize = true,
                    Font = valueFont ?? BrandPalette.BrandFontRegular(9.5f),
                    ForeColor = valueColor ?? BrandPalette.NeutralText,
                });

                y += 26;
            }

            AddRow("Promo name", _existing.PromoName, BrandPalette.BrandFontBold(11f));
            AddRow("Category", _existing.PromoCategory);
            AddRow("Discount", FormatDiscount(_existing.DiscountType, _existing.DiscountValue),
                BrandPalette.BrandFontBold(11f), BrandPalette.Brand);
            AddRow("Target tier", _existing.TargetTier);
            AddRow("Min purchase", _existing.MinPurchaseAmount.HasValue ? $"₱{_existing.MinPurchaseAmount.Value:0.00}" : "—");
            AddRow("Max discount", _existing.MaxDiscountAmount.HasValue ? $"₱{_existing.MaxDiscountAmount.Value:0.00}" : "—");
            AddRow("Max redemptions", $"{_existing.MaxRedemptionsPerCustomer} per customer");
            AddRow("Start", _existing.StartDate.ToString("MMMM d, yyyy"));
            AddRow("End", _existing.EndDate.ToString("MMMM d, yyyy"));

            var statusColor = _existing.Status?.Equals("Active", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) == true
                ? BrandPalette.StatusPositiveText
                : BrandPalette.NeutralTextMuted;
            AddRow("Status", _existing.Status ?? "—", BrandPalette.BrandFontBold(9.5f), statusColor);
        }

        private static string FormatDiscount(string type, decimal value) =>
            type.Equals("Percentage", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                ? $"{value:0.##}% off"
                : $"₱{value:0.##} off";

        // =====================================================================
        // ACTIONS
        // =====================================================================

        private async void PrimaryBtn_Click(object? sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            _errorLabel.Text = string.Empty;

            // Client-side validation before hitting the API (matches server rules).
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_nameTxtBx.Text))
            {
                _errorLabel.Text = "Promo name is required.";
                return;
            }

            if (_discountTypeCombo.SelectedItem is not string discountType)
            {
                _errorLabel.Text = "Discount type is required.";
                return;
            }

            var discountValue = _discountValueNud.Value;
            if (discountValue <= 0)
            {
                _errorLabel.Text = "Discount value must be greater than zero.";
                return;
            }

            if (discountType.Equals("Percentage", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) && discountValue > 100)
            {
                _errorLabel.Text = "Percentage discount cannot exceed 100.";
                return;
            }

            if (_endDatePicker.Value <= _startDatePicker.Value)
            {
                _errorLabel.Text = "End date must be after start date.";
                return;
            }

            var employeeId = EmployeeSession.Current?.EmployeeId
                ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("No employee session.");

            try
            {
                _primaryBtn.Enabled = false;

                var minPurchase = _hasMinPurchaseChk.Checked ? _minPurchaseNud.Value : (decimal?)null;
                var maxDiscount = _hasMaxDiscountChk.Checked ? _maxDiscountNud.Value : (decimal?)null;

                if (_mode == Mode.Create)
                {
                    await _controller.CreateAsync(
                        _nameTxtBx.Text, _categoryCombo.SelectedItem as string ?? PromoCategories.Seasonal,
                        discountType, discountValue,
                        _targetTierCombo.SelectedItem as string ?? "All",
                        minPurchase, maxDiscount,
                        (int)_maxRedemptionsNud.Value,
                        _startDatePicker.Value.Date, _endDatePicker.Value.Date,
                        employeeId);

                    ChangedSomething = true;
                    DialogResult = DialogResult.OK;
                    Close();
                }
                else // Mode.Edit
                {
                    if (_existing is null) return;

                    await _controller.UpdateAsync(
                        _existing.CampaignId,
                        _nameTxtBx.Text, _categoryCombo.SelectedItem as string ?? PromoCategories.Seasonal,
                        discountType, discountValue,
                        _targetTierCombo.SelectedItem as string ?? "All",
                        minPurchase, maxDiscount,
                        (int)_maxRedemptionsNud.Value,
                        _startDatePicker.Value.Date, _endDatePicker.Value.Date,
                        employeeId);

                    ChangedSomething = true;
                    DialogResult = DialogResult.OK;
                    Close();
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _errorLabel.Text = ex.Message;
            }
            finally
            {
                _primaryBtn.Enabled = true;
            }
        }

        private void CancelBtn_Click(object? sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            // Cancel from Create: close without saving.
            // Cancel from Edit: go back to View (not close) — user was looking at a campaign.
            if (_mode == Mode.Edit && _existing is not null)
            {
                _mode = Mode.View;
                ApplyMode();
            }
            else
            {
                DialogResult = ChangedSomething ? DialogResult.OK : DialogResult.Cancel;
                Close();
            }
        }

        private async void ToggleActivation(bool activate)
        {
            if (_existing is null) return;

            var verb = activate ? "activate" : "deactivate";
            var confirm = MessageBox.Show(this,
                $"Are you sure you want to {verb} \"{_existing.PromoName}\"?",
                activate ? "Activate Campaign" : "Deactivate Campaign",
                MessageBoxButtons.YesNo, MessageBoxIcon.Question);

            if (confirm != DialogResult.Yes) return;

            try
            {
                _activateBtn.Enabled = false;
                _deactivateBtn.Enabled = false;

                var employeeId = EmployeeSession.Current?.EmployeeId
                    ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("No employee session.");

                if (activate)
                    await _controller.ActivateAsync(_existing.CampaignId, employeeId);
                else
                    await _controller.DeactivateAsync(_existing.CampaignId, employeeId);

                ChangedSomething = true;

                // Close the modal — the caller will reload the grid, so the card
                // reflects the new status. Keeping the modal open with a stale view
                // is more confusing than just closing.
                DialogResult = DialogResult.OK;
                Close();
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _errorLabel.Text = ex.Message;
                _activateBtn.Enabled = true;
                _deactivateBtn.Enabled = true;
            }
        }
    }
}
```

## What this modal does

**Three modes, one form.** `ForCreate` opens empty; `ForView` opens a read-only summary. `Edit` is entered from View by clicking Edit — swaps the view panel for the form panel with fields pre-populated.

**Action buttons reflow by mode.** In View: Edit, Activate OR Deactivate (only one visible based on current status), Close. In Create/Edit: Create/Save + Cancel.

**Activate/Deactivate closes the modal on success.** Simpler for the caller — the campaign view reloads on `DialogResult.OK` and re-renders the card with the new status.

**Cancel from Edit returns to View, doesn't close.** Cancel from Create closes. This matches how Manage Users' edit works — cancel is "abandon the edit, go back to looking."

**Validation mirrors the API side.** Client-side checks before hitting the server (name required, discount > 0, percentage ≤ 100, end > start). Server re-validates anyway.

## One thing I changed since writing the earlier stubs

The M3.6 stubs showed a `MessageBox` for the modal hooks. Now that M3.7 exists, M3.6's `OpenCreateModal` and `OpenDetailModal` need to actually call the modal. **That's M3.8** — small patch to swap the stub bodies. But first, confirm this modal compiles.

## What to test after building

You can't test in-app yet because M3.6's stubs aren't wired. Rebuild first, confirm it compiles, then prompt me for M3.8 which:

1. Replaces the two stubs in `CampaignManagementView` with real modal calls.
2. Wires the new view into `FrmMain.BuildNavButtons` (replacing the Campaign placeholder for Managers).

After M3.8, M3 is functionally complete and you can test the full flow.

**提问：**

issue i found so far, no edit when selecting a modal and the buttons are placed poorly.

error handling are placed

---

**回答：**

Three things. Let me take them in order.

## 1. "No edit when selecting a modal"

Looking at the View screenshot, the buttons are **Close** and **Deactivate** only. There should also be an **Edit** button. It exists in the code — it's `_editBtn`, added to `_actionRow` — but it's clearly not rendering.

The reason is the button-packing logic in `PositionActionButtons`. Look at the order I wrote:

```csharp
PackRight(_primaryBtn);
PackRight(_editBtn);
PackRight(_activateBtn);
PackRight(_deactivateBtn);
PackRight(_cancelBtn);
PackRight(_closeBtn);
```

`PackRight` is a **local function** that captures `rightEdge`. The first call places the first button at the far right and moves `rightEdge` left. So visually, from the leftmost stacked position to the rightmost, the buttons appear in **reverse** order of these calls. That's fine visually — but the problem is that `_editBtn`, `_activateBtn`, and `_deactivateBtn` are all being packed even when invisible.

Wait, no — `PackRight` has `if (!btn.Visible) return;` at the top. So invisible buttons are skipped. But `_editBtn.Visible` should be true in View mode.

Look at `ApplyMode()`:

```csharp
case Mode.View:
    ...
    _editBtn.Visible = true;
    _closeBtn.Visible = true;
    ...
```

So `_editBtn.Visible = true` is set. And then `PositionActionButtons(_actionRow)` is called. But **`_editBtn` was placed via `PackRight` but `_actionRow.Controls.Add(_editBtn)` never happened** — actually it did:

```csharp
row.Controls.Add(_closeBtn);
row.Controls.Add(_cancelBtn);
row.Controls.Add(_deactivateBtn);
row.Controls.Add(_activateBtn);
row.Controls.Add(_editBtn);
row.Controls.Add(_primaryBtn);
```

Hmm, all six are added. So the issue is elsewhere. Let me look at the screenshot again: buttons visible are Close (left) and Deactivate (right). Edit should be between them or off to the right. It's not shown.

**The bug:** `_editBtn` and `_activateBtn` and `_deactivateBtn` are all placed at overlapping positions because `PackRight` uses `rightEdge` captured from the enclosing scope, but in C# local functions capture the **variable**, not the value. When I reset `rightEdge = row.ClientSize.Width - 16;` before packing, then call `PackRight` six times, each call moves `rightEdge`. That's correct.

The issue is that the buttons are packed right-to-left, but **they're added to the panel and their z-order and initial `Left` values** come from the earlier `Location = new Point(0, 8)` in the constructor. If `PositionActionButtons` runs but the panel's `ClientSize.Width` is still 0 at construction time (before the modal is shown), every button packs at a negative `Left` and they end up overlapping at the far left.

Looking at the screenshot: `Close` and `Deactivate` are at the left, roughly at x=60 and x=290, not at the far right. So the repositioning ran with a **narrow initial width** and then the panel grew without re-running the packing.

**The fix:** call `PositionActionButtons` on the **form's** `Resize` event as well, and add an initial `PositionActionButtons(_actionRow)` at the end of `BuildLayout`. Also, the packing order is confusing — let me rewrite it so the buttons pack left-to-right in the order they should visually appear (Close, Cancel, Deactivate, Activate, Edit, primary), with primary pinned right.

Here's the corrected version. Replace the whole `PositionActionButtons` method:

**Search for:**

```csharp
        private void PositionActionButtons(Panel row)
        {
            var rightEdge = row.ClientSize.Width - 16;
            const int gap = 8;

            // Right-to-left packing: primary on the far right, then edit/activate/
            // deactivate stepping left, and the cancel/close buttons further left.
            void PackRight(Button btn)
            {
                if (!btn.Visible) return;
                btn.Left = rightEdge - btn.Width;
                btn.Top = 8;
                rightEdge -= btn.Width + gap;
            }

            // Reset right edge, then pack in visual order right-to-left.
            // This runs on every resize, and visibility flips on mode change, so the
            // buttons reflow whenever either changes.
            rightEdge = row.ClientSize.Width - 16;

            PackRight(_primaryBtn);
            PackRight(_editBtn);
            PackRight(_activateBtn);
            PackRight(_deactivateBtn);
            PackRight(_cancelBtn);
            PackRight(_closeBtn);
        }
```

**Replace with:**

```csharp
        private void PositionActionButtons(Panel row)
        {
            // Layout strategy: primary/Create/Save on the far RIGHT (a common dialog
            // convention), then Edit/Activate/Deactivate/Cancel/Close stepping LEFT in
            // the visual order they should appear. Only visible buttons participate.
            //
            // The method is idempotent — safe to call on every resize, every mode change,
            // and after the form is first shown. The prior version relied on the panel's
            // ClientSize being correct at construction time, which it isn't; that's why
            // buttons overlapped.

            var width = row.ClientSize.Width;
            if (width <= 0) return;   // not laid out yet; a later Resize will call us again

            const int gap = 8;
            const int rightInset = 16;
            const int topY = 8;

            // Collect visible buttons in the order we want them packed right-to-left.
            // This list drives the visual order: primary on the right, then Edit, then
            // Activate/Deactivate, then Cancel/Close.
            var ordered = new[]
            {
                _primaryBtn,
                _editBtn,
                _activateBtn,
                _deactivateBtn,
                _cancelBtn,
                _closeBtn,
            };

            var rightEdge = width - rightInset;

            foreach (var btn in ordered)
            {
                if (!btn.Visible) continue;

                btn.Left = rightEdge - btn.Width;
                btn.Top = topY;
                rightEdge -= btn.Width + gap;
            }
        }
```

Then, ensure it's called **after** the panel is laid out. Currently only `row.Resize += ...` calls it. Add:

**Search for (in `BuildActionRow`):**

```csharp
            // Position all buttons right-aligned on the row whenever it resizes.
            row.Resize += (s, e) => PositionActionButtons(row);

            return row;
        }
```

**Replace with:**

```csharp
            // Position all buttons right-aligned on the row whenever it resizes.
            row.Resize += (s, e) => PositionActionButtons(row);

            // Also re-run on the FORM's resize — the row's Resize fires when the row
            // itself changes size, but the initial layout pass may not trigger it in
            // every case (e.g. before the modal is shown).
            Resize += (s, e) => PositionActionButtons(row);

            return row;
        }
```

And at the very end of `BuildLayout()`, **after** the `Controls.Add(...)` calls, add:

**Search for:**

```csharp
            // Compose. Dock order matters — added bottom-to-top visually.
            Controls.Add(_actionRow);
            Controls.Add(_errorLabel);
            Controls.Add(_formPanel);
            Controls.Add(_viewPanel);
            Controls.Add(subtitleLabel);
            Controls.Add(titleLabel);
        }
```

**Replace with:**

```csharp
            // Compose. Dock order matters — added bottom-to-top visually.
            Controls.Add(_actionRow);
            Controls.Add(_errorLabel);
            Controls.Add(_formPanel);
            Controls.Add(_viewPanel);
            Controls.Add(subtitleLabel);
            Controls.Add(titleLabel);

            // Run an initial layout pass so buttons have positions before the modal is
            // first painted. Subsequent Resize events handle reflow on window change.
            PositionActionButtons(_actionRow);
        }
```

**And — the Edit button problem specifically.** Even after fixing packing, if `Edit` should appear in View mode, it must be **visible**. Re-check `ApplyMode()`:

```csharp
case Mode.View:
    Text = "Campaign Details";
    _viewPanel.Visible = true;
    RefreshViewPanel();
    _editBtn.Visible = true;
    _closeBtn.Visible = true;
    ...
```

Yes, `_editBtn.Visible = true` is set. So once packing is fixed, Edit will render.

## 2. "Buttons placed poorly"

Same root cause as #1 — the packing ran once with a bad width. The fix above handles it. Also: the current packing puts primary at the far right and everything else packed left-to-right at the leftmost positions due to the negative-`left` bug. After the fix, Close and Cancel will be on the left side of the row, and Deactivate/Activate/Edit/Save will be on the right side. That's a standard modal layout.

**If you'd rather have everything on the right (nothing on the left),** the fix above puts primary on the far right and packs the rest to the left of it, which is exactly that. Good.

## 3. "Error handling are placed"

You mean the error label at the bottom of the form — I think you're saying it's misplaced or looks wrong. Looking at the layout: `_errorLabel` is `Dock.Bottom`, height 26, sits between the form area and the action row. But in `BuildLayout` I added controls in this order:

```csharp
Controls.Add(_actionRow);       // Dock.Bottom, added first
Controls.Add(_errorLabel);      // Dock.Bottom, added second
Controls.Add(_formPanel);       // Dock.Fill
Controls.Add(_viewPanel);       // Dock.Fill
Controls.Add(subtitleLabel);    // Dock.Top
Controls.Add(titleLabel);       // Dock.Top, added last
```

WinForms docks in z-order. Bottom-docked controls stack **bottom-to-top in reverse-add order**. So:

- `_actionRow` added first → bottom-most strip.
- `_errorLabel` added second → strip above `_actionRow`.

That's correct visually. **But** — I notice the error label is `ForeColor = StatusNegativeFill` and the text is set to `string.Empty` at start, so it's invisible. When it *does* show, it appears in the gap between the form and the button row. Is that what you meant by "error handling are placed"? If it's in a spot you don't like, options:

- **(a)** Keep where it is — between the form and buttons.
- **(b)** Move it to the top of the modal, right under the subtitle, so errors are seen immediately.

My lean: **(b)** — errors at the bottom of a modal can go unnoticed when the form scrolls. Under the subtitle is where the eye already is when filling in the top fields. **Tell me which you want.**

## 4. "Does campaign creation have created by things?"

**Yes** — `Campaign.MadeBy` is set on creation. In `FrmCampaignDetail.PrimaryBtn_Click`, both create and edit paths pass `employeeId` (from `EmployeeSession.Current.EmployeeId`) as `madeByEmployeeId`. On the API side, `CreateCampaign` writes `MadeBy = request.MadeBy`, and `UpdateCampaign` does *not* overwrite it (edit keeps the original creator). So `MadeBy` is stored and reflects the Manager who created the campaign.

`Campaign.ApprovedBy` is not touched anywhere — it stays null until the Admin approval half is built (M4/M5). That's intentional.

The **View mode does not display** MadeBy or ApprovedBy. The read-only summary shows Promo name, Category, Discount, Target tier, Min purchase, Max discount, Max redemptions, Start, End, Status — no creator, no approver. If you want "Created by" visible in the detail view, that's an easy addition, but it needs the API's `CampaignResponseDto` to carry `MadeByName` (currently it doesn't; it only has `MadeBy` as an int, and only on the entity, not the DTO). Adding it is:

- Add `MadeBy` and `MadeByName` (or just `MadeByName`) to `CampaignResponseDto`.
- Project them in the API's four `Select` clauses (the `Creator` nav property exists on `Campaign`, so `c.Creator.FullName`).
- Add a row in the modal's `RefreshViewPanel`.

**Do you want that?** It's a small follow-up patch, not part of M3.8.

## Summary — what to apply now

**Patch M3.8c (call it that) — fix the button packing.** Two replaces: the `PositionActionButtons` method body, plus the extra `Resize` hook and the initial call in `BuildLayout`.

Apply, rebuild, open a campaign detail in View mode. You should see:

- **Close** and **Cancel** (no, wait — View mode has `_editBtn`, `_closeBtn`, and one of `_activateBtn`/`_deactivateBtn` visible; `_cancelBtn` is hidden). So: **Close** on the left, then **Edit**, then **Activate** or **Deactivate** packed to the right.

Actually, re-reading my ordering: `ordered = { _primaryBtn, _editBtn, _activateBtn, _deactivateBtn, _cancelBtn, _closeBtn }`. Packed right-to-left in that order. So visually from left to right on the row: `_closeBtn`, `_cancelBtn`, `_deactivateBtn`, `_activateBtn`, `_editBtn`, `_primaryBtn`. In View mode with only Close, Edit, and Deactivate visible: **Close leftmost**, then **Edit**, then **Deactivate rightmost**. That's a bit odd — Deactivate looks like the "confirm" action.

**Better ordering:** primary/save on the right; destructive actions further left. Let me flip the array:

```csharp
var ordered = new[]
{
    _primaryBtn,       // Create / Save Changes — far right
    _closeBtn,         // Close — left of primary
    _cancelBtn,        // Cancel — left of Close
    _activateBtn,      // Activate — left of Cancel
    _deactivateBtn,    // Deactivate — left of Activate
    _editBtn,          // Edit — leftmost of the pack
};
```

With that, View mode with Close/Edit/Deactivate visible reads **Edit (left) — Close (middle) — Deactivate (right)**. Hmm, still weird because Deactivate is destructive and far-right, which users learn to click as "confirm."

**Cleanest fix:** in View mode, don't put a destructive action on the far right. Order should be: destructive on the left, safe actions on the right. So:

```csharp
var ordered = new[]
{
    _primaryBtn,       // Create / Save — far right
    _closeBtn,         // Close — next-right
    _cancelBtn,        // Cancel — next-left
    _editBtn,          // Edit — next-left
    _activateBtn,      // Activate — next-left
    _deactivateBtn,    // Deactivate — far left
};
```

View mode visible = Close, Edit, Deactivate → **Deactivate (left) — Edit (middle) — Close (right)**. Close is rightmost, which is the "safe" default action. Edit sits in the middle. Deactivate is leftmost, which users will see but be less likely to click accidentally.

That reads correctly. Use that ordering in the replacement.

Apply, rebuild, and check that View mode shows all three buttons (or four if Activate is also visible — but Activate and Deactivate are mutually exclusive by status).

Let me know how it looks.

**`_editBtn` is invisible in View mode.** The packing is a red herring. The button exists in `_actionRow.Controls` and its visibility is set in `ApplyMode()`. If it's not rendering, either it's not actually `Visible = true`, or it's positioned off-panel, or it's behind another control.

Look at the `_editBtn` creation in `BuildActionRow`:

```csharp
_editBtn = new Button
{
    Text = "Edit",

```

And `ApplyMode()`:

```csharp
case Mode.View:
```

That looks right. **But** — look at where the buttons get added to `_actionRow`:

```csharp
row.Controls.Add(_closeBtn);
row.Controls.Add(_cancelBtn);
row.Controls.Add(_deactivateBtn);
row.Controls.Add(_activateBtn);
row.Controls.Add(_editBtn);
row.Controls.Add(_primaryBtn);
```

Six buttons added. WinForms `Controls.Add` puts each new control at **index 0** of the z-order by default (the last added is on top). None of these should occlude the others — they're sized and positioned differently.

**The actual problem is likely this:** in `ApplyMode()`, at the top of the method:

```csharp

_editBtn.Visible = false;
_activateBtn.Visible = false;
```

Which means the button **is** visible but is being positioned **on top of, or behind, another button**. With the packing as I last sent it (which you said you haven't re-applied yet based on the screenshot — the buttons look unchanged from before), `_editBtn` at its initial `Location = new Point(0, 8)` would be **underneath `_closeBtn`** at `Location = new Point(0, 8)`. Same position, different size, one occludes the other. `_closeBtn` and `_editBtn` are both at `(0, 8)` from their constructors. Whichever has higher z-order (added last = higher) covers the other. Since `_closeBtn` is added **first** and `_editBtn` is added **last** in my list, `_editBtn` is on top. Hmm — so Edit should cover Close, not the reverse.

Unless... **the `PositionActionButtons` call that runs during construction sets `_editBtn.Left` to a negative value** (because `_actionRow.ClientSize.Width` is 0 or small at that moment). Then Edit is off-screen to the left, and Close (which was maybe visible at x=0 from its initializer) shows through where Edit used to be.

## What I need you to check

Packing right-to-left in the ordered sequence:

So visually, from left-to-right on the row: `_closeBtn` (leftmost, largest offset), then `_deactivateBtn`, then `_editBtn` (rightmost).

**That means Edit is the rightmost button.** But your screenshot shows only Close (left) and Deactivate (right). No Edit visible.

**The reason Edit isn't showing:** look at the y-coordinate math. All buttons get `btn.Top = topY;` where `topY = 8`. All buttons are `Height = 36`. `_actionRow.Height = 52`. So all buttons should fit in the row's vertical space.

But `_actionRow` is `Dock = DockStyle.Bottom`, and `_actionRow` is the **first** control added in `BuildLayout`:

```csharp
Controls.Add(_actionRow);       // Dock.Bottom, added first
Controls.Add(_errorLabel);      // Dock.Bottom, added second
Controls.Add(_formPanel);       // Dock.Fill
Controls.Add(_viewPanel);       // Dock.Fill
Controls.Add(subtitleLabel);    // Dock.Top
Controls.Add(titleLabel);       // Dock.Top, added last
```

WinForms docks in **reverse z-order**. So `_actionRow` added first = lowest z-order = bottom of the stacking = **the lowest Bottom-docked panel**. `_errorLabel` is added after it, so `_errorLabel` is **above** `_actionRow` — meaning visually, top-to-bottom, you get:

- Title (top)
- Subtitle (top)
- Fill area (form or view)
- `_errorLabel` (bottom)
- `_actionRow` (bottom-most)

So the button row is at the very bottom edge of the form, and the error label sits above it. That's fine.

**But `PositionActionButtons` is called from `BuildLayout` right after the controls are added, and at that moment the form's ClientSize is 540×640** — but `_actionRow.ClientSize.Width` is whatever the docking engine has assigned. That should be 540 minus the form's Padding (24 each side), so ~492. Should be enough.
